title: First Input-Head Rewind Step
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with state sets $S_E$ and $S_G$, and suppose $E$ has at least one work tape. Choose states $e_0,e_f\in S_E$ and $g_0,g_f\in S_G$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. In the machine constructed from $E$, $G$, and these states, one step from the configuration whose state is the initial input-rewind state, whose input head is at position $|x|+1$, whose first work tape stores $x$ from cell zero and whose other work tapes are blank, with every work-tape head at position zero and empty output, yields the configuration with the input-rewind state, input head at position $|x|$, unchanged work tapes and head positions, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ has at least one work tape
